sources: Runway Gen-4 Video Prompting Guide — separates subject motion from camera motion
_meta.principle: ONE subject-motion verb per shot. Subject motion is what the SUBJECT does — independent of camera. Stack with camera-moves.json for compound shots, but never stack subject-motion verbs.
_meta.interpolation_rule: Verbs must be physically grounded — 'hand reaches into frame' not 'subject moves emotionally'. Abstract verbs drift in I2V models.

head_turn_to_camera.name: Head Turn to Camera
head_turn_to_camera.fragment: [SUBJECT] turns head smoothly toward camera, eye contact lands at the end of the motion

hand_enters_frame.name: Hand Enters Frame
hand_enters_frame.use: Introduce a product or tool — hand reaches in from offscreen
hand_enters_frame.fragment: a hand enters frame from screen-left and lifts [SUBJECT], steady controlled motion

shoulder_settle.name: Shoulder Settle
shoulder_settle.use: Talking-head opener, tension release — subject visibly relaxes into frame
shoulder_settle.fragment: [SUBJECT] settles shoulders down, exhales, posture softens, ready to speak

object_snap_to_grip.name: Object Snap to Grip
object_snap_to_grip.use: Knife/tool reveal — object closes into a satisfying held position
object_snap_to_grip.fragment: [SUBJECT] closes/snaps into grip with a single decisive motion, locks into final pose

product_rotates_180.name: Product Rotates 180
product_rotates_180.use: Show all sides of a product without camera move — turntable feel
product_rotates_180.fragment: [SUBJECT] rotates slowly on its axis to reveal the opposite face, smooth even rotation no wobble

fabric_unfolds.name: Fabric Unfolds
fabric_unfolds.use: Apparel reveal — garment opens or drapes
fabric_unfolds.fragment: [SUBJECT] unfolds and drapes naturally, fabric weight visible in the fall, no glitching

environmental._label: Environmental subject motion — liquid, particle, screen

liquid_pours.name: Liquid Pours
liquid_pours.use: Coffee, milk, sauce — pour into vessel, splash optional
liquid_pours.fragment: liquid pours smoothly from [SUBJECT] into the vessel below, surface settles flat at the end

screen_content_changes.name: Screen Content Changes
screen_content_changes.use: App / UI reveals — phone or laptop display swaps content cleanly
screen_content_changes.fragment: the screen on [SUBJECT] transitions cleanly to a new view, content shifts without flicker or distortion

steam_rises.name: Steam Rises
steam_rises.use: Coffee cup, hot food, warm scene atmosphere
steam_rises.fragment: steam rises gently from [SUBJECT], soft wisps that drift upward and dissipate
